reuse.why: Adds the guard next to the existing assertNotAlreadyLinked inside the shared linkBankAccount that every provider-specific link handler funnels through.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the only overlap is a second lookup of the upgrading account row that saveLinkedAccount also performs.

placement.why: The rule lives as a precondition in accounts/app.ts's common link path, mirroring the existing assert helper pattern.

scope.why: One helper, one call, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, clearly named guard in the single entry point; easy to own.

one_place.where: assertNotClosed called once in linkBankAccount (server/accounts/app.ts), which all GoCardless/SimpleFin/other link handlers delegate to.
